about: Brand Fusion is a curated matchmaking event that connects Fortune 500 and Emerging brand leaders with innovative startups through structured 15-minute meetings. Since 2012, we've brought together the brightest minds in brand innovation and startup technology to forge partnerships that drive real business results.

Brands submit their toughest business challenges. Venture capitalists and accelerators nominate their most relevant startups. Our team personally curates each pairing, drawing on deep knowledge of both sides to create a full day of high-impact meetings.
tagline: Where Fortune 500 and Emerging Brands Meet Game-Changing Startups
for_brands: Submit your business challenges and meet pre-vetted startups hand-picked to solve them. Discover cutting-edge technology, explore partnerships, and stay ahead of the innovation curve — all in one day.
for_startups: Get face-to-face with decision-makers from the world's biggest brands. Each 15-minute meeting is a chance to demo your solution, build relationships, and close deals with companies that can transform your growth trajectory.

faqs.a: Brand Fusion is a curated matchmaking event that connects Fortune 500 and Emerging brand leaders with innovative startups through structured 15-minute meetings. Our team personally curates each pairing, drawing on deep knowledge of both sides to create a full day of high-impact meetings.

faqs.q: When is Brand Fusion 2026 Powered by Markup AI?
faqs.a: Brand Fusion 2026 Powered by Markup AI takes place over two days: a Welcome Dinner on Tuesday, October 6, and a full Matchmaking Day on Wednesday, October 7, 2026.
Brand Fusion is designed for brand-side marketing and innovation leaders, startup founders and executives, and venture capitalists / accelerator partners who nominate startups.
The Welcome Dinner is held at SparkHaus, 727 Madison Ave, Covington, KY. It's walkable from Hotel Covington.
Matchmaking Day takes place at TQL Stadium, 1508 John St, Cincinnati, OH. Brand-startup meetings are held in the stadium's private suites, with meals and kickoff in the Tunnel Club.

faqs.q: How far apart are the venues?
faqs.a: SparkHaus and TQL Stadium are both within a short drive of Hotel Covington. SparkHaus is walkable from the hotel. TQL Stadium is approximately a 5-minute drive across the river.

faqs.q: What happens at the Welcome Dinner?
faqs.a: The Welcome Dinner on Tuesday evening is an opportunity to meet fellow attendees in a relaxed setting. It includes cocktails starting at 5 PM, dinner at 6 PM, a bourbon tasting, and desserts at 7 PM.

You'll receive a personalized meeting schedule before the event. On Wednesday, you'll have back-to-back 15-minute meetings in private suites at TQL Stadium from 8:40 AM to 12:45 PM, with a snack break mid-morning. The day starts with breakfast and a kickoff at 7:30 AM and ends with a closing lunch.
Each brand-startup meeting is 15 minutes. Brands stay in their assigned suite while startups rotate between suites throughout the day.

faqs.q: Will I know my schedule in advance?
faqs.a: Yes. Your personalized meeting schedule will be shared before the event so you can prepare for each meeting.
Hotel Covington, 638 Madison Avenue, Covington, KY 41011. Walkable to the Welcome Dinner at SparkHaus and about five minutes from TQL Stadium. Use our booking link below to reserve a room.

faqs.q: What airport should I fly into?
faqs.a: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (CVG) is approximately 15 minutes from Hotel Covington and the event venues.
Parking information for both SparkHaus and TQL Stadium will be shared closer to the event. Both venues have nearby parking options.
Business casual is the recommended dress code for both the Welcome Dinner and Matchmaking Day. Comfortable shoes are recommended as you'll be moving between suites.

faqs.q: Should I bring materials or a presentation?
faqs.a: Startups: We recommend a brief pitch or demo that fits within the 15-minute meeting window. Keep it conversational rather than a formal presentation. Brands: Come prepared to discuss your challenges and what solutions you're looking for.
Yes. The Welcome Dinner on Day 1 and breakfast plus a closing lunch on Day 2 are all included.

faqs.q: Is there Wi-Fi at the venues?
faqs.a: Yes, Wi-Fi is available at both venues. Details will be provided on-site.

faqs.q: Who do I contact with questions?
faqs.a: Reach out to the Brand Fusion team at dave@bluenorthky.com for any questions about the event, logistics, or your schedule.

faqs.q: What if I need to cancel or change my attendance?
faqs.a: Please contact us as soon as possible at dave@bluenorthky.com so we can adjust the meeting schedule accordingly.
